Search-depth settings were not converted into semantic prohibitions. Positive results can use an explicit witness; negative reachability requires exhaustive closure or an invariant, not merely search exhaustion.
Bulk cases evaluate the supplied request size and existence of completion, not guaranteed first-poll success or the entire 1-200 advertised range.
